PROC

IF

AND
NOT DB_WYR_Chess_KingAttackHandled(1)
AND

AND
GetHitpoints(S_WYR_Chess_King1_cd2393b5-fccc-4e0f-8592-16f85f078edf, _HP)
AND
_HP < _OldHP
THEN
